articles.title: Crypto industry reacts after Clarity Act fails Senate vote
articles.snippet: One of the most crucial U.S. regulations for crypto markets couldn't secure enough support to clear the Senate's final 60-vote hurdle.

articles.title: Crypto Clarity Act flames out in failed U.S. Senate vote
articles.snippet: The years-long effort to set U.S. regulations for crypto markets couldn't muster enough support to make the leap over the Senate's final 60-vote hurdle.

articles.title: A hacker turned 25 cents of bitcoin into 46 billion fake BTC tokens on a DeFi bridge
articles.snippet: Two software bugs allowed the attacker to create more than 2,000 times Bitcoin’s maximum supply in unbacked syBTC. Symbiosis puts preliminary losses at 9.97 BTC.

articles.title: Live updates: Clarity Act fails in Senate, sending crypto lower
articles.snippet: The failure essentially ends market structure legislative work in the Senate for 2026 and is a major blow to the crypto industry, which has invested years and hundreds of millions of dollars trying to support its interests.

articles.title: XRP Ledger is one vote away from starting its next big payments upgrade
articles.snippet: Batch V1.1 would let users bundle up to eight linked transactions into one operation, with 27 of 35 trusted validators now backing the change.
